notes.title: Duelfront Demo is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45210803/89a54d0f58c2289e7333f6b60392a648bc67e62f.png[/img]
🕗 Start Time: October 8, 2024, 10:00 AM UTC
⏰ End Time: October 22, 2024, 10:00 AM UTC
🎮 Duration: 2 Weeks

Join us as we unveil the Duelfront demo! Whether you’re a developer or a card game enthusiast, we’re excited to play alongside you. Dive into epic battles and showcase your skills!

[h1]🔥 Launch Events:[/h1]

[h2]1️⃣ Leaderboard Challenge[/h2]

Duration: Entire demo period (October 8 - October 22)
Prizes:
[list]
[*] 🥇 1st Place: 60 packs
[*] 🥈 2nd Place: 40 packs
[*] 🥉 3rd-5th Place: 30 packs each
[*] 🏅 6th-10th Place: 20 packs each
[*] 🎟 Top 100: 10 packs each
[/list]
Top 3 Display: The top three players will be featured on the historical season leaderboard in future updates.
Note: Rewards will be distributed to your accounts in the next season.

[h2]2️⃣ Developer Showdown[/h2]

Where: Discord
How to Participate: Contact us on Discord to arrange your matches.
Format: Best-of-3 (BO3).
Rewards:
[list]
[*] 🏆 Winners: 10 packs each
[*] 🎁 Participants: 5 packs each
[/list]
Note: If there are many participants, matches will be scheduled on a rotating basis. Rewards will be directly credited to your accounts.

[h1]🃏 New to Duelfront?[/h1]

No worries! Check out our beginner-friendly decks here. We’ll keep them updated regularly to help you get started.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3345192810

[h1]📅 Important Info:[/h1]

The demo runs from October 8 to October 22, 2024.
After the demo, all user data will be deleted.
But don’t worry! Your achievements will earn you rewards in the next season. 🎁


[h1]🎥 Join Us Live:[/h1]

We’re streaming live on Discord! Chat with us in real-time by leaving a comment or tuning into our Discord stream here.

[h1]💬 We Value Your Feedback:[/h1]

Have suggestions or feedback? Drop a comment below or visit the feedback thread in our community. We’re listening!
Get ready to strategize, compete, and have fun! Let’s make this demo unforgettable! 🚀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206290

notes.title: About the Game, Our Team, and You
notes.content:
We’re Limit, a small team of two game developers from China. For us, "Limit" means pushing the boundaries, never compromising. We've faced countless obstacles as self-taught developers, no publishers, no investors, but our love for games kept us going.

Before this, we made 22 games, but none of them met our standards. Each one taught us something new, and every time, we got better. The process was tough, but we knew we were getting closer.

Now, our 23rd game is here. We’ve refined it, played it daily, and believe it’s the best we’ve ever made. It’s simple, fun, and something that will stand the test of time.

[h1]The game[/h1]

When I play chess, starcraft or civilization, it’s all about planning my moves across the map — making every decision feel clever and strategic. Now, imagine getting that same feeling in a card game. Duelfront brings battlefield positioning and map control into the world of card battles, adding depth while keeping it simple and elegant.

We’ve drawn inspiration from the legends like Hearthstone, Gwent, and Marvel Snap, but Duelfront brings something new to the table — smart deployment and outthinking your opponent.

You can click the link below to check out the Duelfront gameplay explain.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3336473719

Add Duelfront to your wishlist now. We’re launching demo soon, and you won’t want to miss it. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206290/Duelfront/

Ask us anything, drop a comment below, and we’ll do our best to reply!

With the warmest of regards,
Limit Game Studio
